description: Source code for handling BCM4908 firmware images, including parsing, creating, extracting, and managing boot filesystem within the image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a buffer.

methods.name: bcm4908img_open
methods.description: Opens a file or stdin with safety checks.

methods.name: bcm4908img_close
methods.description: Closes a file if not stdin.

methods.name: bcm4908img_calc_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of the image data.

methods.name: bcm4908img_parse
methods.description: Parses the firmware image to extract offsets and validate.

methods.name: bcm4908img_info
methods.description: Displays information about the firmware image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_append_file
methods.description: Appends file data to the image during creation.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_append_zeros
methods.description: Appends zeros to the image for alignment or padding.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_align
methods.description: Aligns the image to a specified boundary with zeros.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create
methods.description: Creates a new firmware image with specified data and options.

methods.name: bcm4908img_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified data segments from the firmware image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_ls
methods.description: Lists files in the boot filesystem.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_mv
methods.description: Renames files within the boot filesystem.
